ValidationRule.description: Sales Order requires: Invoice Summary Fully Paid (supersedes DEC-014 first-payment-only, 2026-09-19), a vehicle selected and In Stock, and a Reserved reservation for that vehicle (LFRDN-661, confirmed 2026-09-21).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(AF_SOStatus__c, "Generated"), ISCHANGED(AF_SOStatus__c), OR( ISBLANK(AF_InvoiceSummary__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(AF_InvoiceSummary__r.AF_Status__c, "Fully Paid")), ISBLANK(AF_SelectedVehicle__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(AF_SelectedVehicle__r.AF_InventoryStatus__c, "In Stock")), ISBLANK(AF_VehicleReservation__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(AF_VehicleReservation__r.AF_Status__c, "Reserved")), AF_VehicleReservation__r.AF_Vehicle__c <> AF_SelectedVehicle__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sales Order cannot be generated: the Invoice Summary must be Fully Paid (all payments gathered and paid), a vehicle must be selected and In Stock, and there must be a Reserved reservation on this Opportunity for that same vehicle.
